We need select correct. Reaction: NO2 (dimer N2O4) into NaOH solution: 2 NO2 + 2 NaOH -> NaNO2 + NaNO3 + H2O. Disproportionation: N +4 to +3 and +5. Main products NaNO2 and NaNO3. So D. Need provide final line 答案：D.

content:
二氧化氮通入 NaOH 溶液中会发生歧化反应：

\[
2NO_2 + 2NaOH \rightarrow NaNO_2 + NaNO_3 + H_2O
\]

氮元素由 +4 价分别变为 +3 价（\(NaNO_2\)）和 +5 价（\(NaNO_3\)），因此主要产物是 \(NaNO_2\) 和 \(NaNO_3\)。

答案：D
